Discover Odisha’s Food Heritage

From the temple kitchens of Puri to village hearths in Nayagarh, Odia food grew around festivals, seasons and rituals. Chhena Poda was born from a baker's patience, Rasabali in the sweet shops of Kendrapara. We exist to keep these dishes on the table.

Our Mission

To bring the rich flavours of Odisha to every home, while preserving our culinary heritage.
